3.3.1 Franca Type Collections
A Franca type collection is a container for Franca data types, corresponding to an
AUTOSAR package. According to the discussion above, each type collection yields
two packages, one for the generated application data types and one for the generated
implementation data types.
[TR_FRANCA_00090] Franca type collection is mapped to AUTOSAR packages ⌈
An FTypeCollection fTypeCollection is mapped to a sub-package of the application
type package FrancaApplicationDataTypes and a sub-package of the implementation
type package FrancaImplementationDataTypes deﬁned in [TR_FRANCA_00010] as
described in Table 3.8, “fTypeCollection mapping to the application type package” and
Table 3.9, “fTypeCollection mapping to the implementation type package” ⌋()
